name: Hot Turkey
review:
Hot Turkey is a festive 7x7 cluster-pays slot with a wild avalanche, exploding wilds and a multiplier grid feature.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.13%.

This holiday version wraps Thunderkick's 7x7 cluster engine in a roast-dinner theme. The free spins carry the multiplier grid between spins, which is where the bigger wins come from.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
